prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Select Companion"]
1: ["Learn Desktop Controls", "How to Interact with Your Pet", "Click to pet, drag to move, or right-click for options. Use system tray to hide or call back your companion.", "Controls Quick Guide"]
2: ["Your Pet is Arriving!", "Preparing Your Pet's New Home", "Tap to interact while your desktop companion finishes hatching!"]
3: ["Secure Your Pet to the Cloud", "Sign in so your pet companion and custom settings are safely saved across restarts and updates.", "Your pet state is permanently linked to your account credentials.", "Cloud Account Protection Active"]
4: ["Use the same login email to keep your adopted pet, stats, and custom items synced safely."]
5: ["Quick Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime for care options."]
6: ["Meet Your New Desktop Workspace Buddy", "Choose your journey: adopt a pre-made companion or build a custom pet to keep you company while you work.", "Start Journey"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your desktop companion adoption is officially registered.", "Certified Desktop Pet Companion"]
8: ["Your pet lives on your desktop screen! Click the system tray icon to summon, hide, or manage your pet anytime."]
9: ["Upload Clear Companion Photos", "For best custom pet results, upload bright, forward-facing photos.", "Upload Checklist: Front view, well-lit, clear background"]
